title: Lahoo Husain Ka Hai Raegaan Na Jayega
body:
Rang Layega Zaroor Rang Layega
Dhaaye Kis Qadar Jahaan Ye Zulm Dhaaye Ga
Hosila Humara Kitna Aazmayega
Aayega Zaroor Aik Waqt Ayega
Warisay Husain Jab Naqab Uthayega
Asalam Fatima Ke Laal Asalam
Shahkaar E Azmay Bay Misaal Asalam
Jisko Teri Na Khudayi Mustarad Karay
Woh Safeena E Hayat Doob Jayega
Sunnatay Rasool Hai Vila Husain Ki
Hai Bahisht Ki Sanad Wafa Husain Ki
Karbala Ko Aansuon Ka Tum Khiraaj Doh
Har Mahazay Zindagi Pe Kaam Ayega
Ye Lahoo Ghareeb O Bay Nawa Ka Ye Lahoo
Ye Lahoo Shaheeday Karbala Ka Ye Lahoo
Ye Lahoo Jo Beh Raha Hai Raigay Garm Par
Ye Lahoo Ajal Ko Zindagi Banayega
Ye Lahoo Husain Ka Nahi Nabi Ka Hai
Fatima Ka Hai Hasan Ka Hai Ali Ka Hai
Doob Jayega Khud Apnay Beheray Zulm May
Iss Lahoo Ki Zad Pe Jo Yazid Ayega
Manzilay Saba Toh Shukr Ka Khaleel Hai
Maa Azeemtar Hai Aur Pidar Jaleel Hai
Aye Yazeed E Bad Sipaat Ye Husain
Sar Jhukayega Nahi Ye Sar Katayega
Karbala May Dukhtaray Rasool Lut Gayi
Qatl Hogaya Pisar Batool Lut Gayi
Raigay Garm Par Parhi Hain Mayatein Tamam
Kya Khabar Thi Aal Par Ye Waqt Aayega
